boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission activities on campus and around Buffalo, with options for art, trails, waterfront time, and public programming.

cards.entity_name: UB Art Gallery, Center for the Arts
cards.title: See a gallery show at UB Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Center for the Arts, UB North Campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading to the Center for the Arts, then give yourselves time to look through the work and compare favorites.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission contemporary-art stop on North Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UB’s Department of Art states that admission to the UB Art Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Circulation Issues, MFA Alumni Photography Duo
cards.access_notes: The cited UB page lists public admission and advises confirming gallery hours or an appointment in advance.

cards.title: Browse UB Anderson Gallery
cards.subtitle: One Martha Jackson Place, near UB South Campus
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided look at the gallery’s exhibition spaces, and check the gallery’s current schedule before traveling to the South Campus area.
cards.short_summary: A University at Buffalo gallery visit with documented free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: University at Buffalo identifies UB Anderson Gallery as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: UB Anderson Gallery Announces Upcoming Exhibitions by Gerald Mead
cards.access_notes: Confirm current exhibitions and hours before visiting; the cited UB release documents the gallery’s free public admission.

cards.title: Walk Tifft’s boardwalks and trails
cards.subtitle: Tifft Nature Preserve, 1200 Fuhrmann Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the preserve’s trails and boardwalks for an unhurried nature walk; bring water and stay on marked paths while watching for birds and wetland views.
cards.short_summary: A free public trail-and-boardwalk outing near the waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Museum of Science states that access to Tifft Nature Preserve’s grounds, boardwalks, and trails is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Buffalo Museum of Science and Tifft Nature Preserve newsletter
cards.access_notes: Trail hours are listed as daily from dawn until dusk; groups of 10 or more require reservations.

cards.title: Take a waterfront walk at Canalside
cards.subtitle: Canalside, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Meet by the water, stroll the public paths, and use the lawn or seating for conversation; skip rentals and food purchases to keep the hang free.
cards.short_summary: A year-round, no-admission Buffalo waterfront gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Canalside is free, open year-round, and open to the public from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; hours may be extended during special events.

cards.title: Play pickup volleyball at the Outer Harbor
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Bring a ball and gather a small group for a casual game on the sand courts; rotate teams so everyone gets a turn without needing a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Public sand-court play with no fee to join.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that volleyball at the Outer Harbor is open to the public and free to play.
cards.access_notes: The waterfront is open daily from dawn to dusk; check the venue calendar for event-related changes.

cards.title: Ride the tracks at Lakeside Bike Park
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Bring your own bike and choose a track that matches the group’s comfort level; helmets and a quick equipment check make the ride more relaxed.
cards.short_summary: A free public bike-park session at the Outer Harbor.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Lakeside Bike Park is free to the public and open from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Bring a personal bike to avoid the optional rental cost.

cards.title: Join the Lakeside Spoke & Social ride
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor; Tuesday evening group ride
cards.notes: Register online or at the event, arrive for the check-in, and join the hour-long slow ride around the Outer Harbor on your own bicycle.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, all-ages social ride with no registration charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront describes The Lakeside Spoke & Social as a free, all-ages ride and requires participants to sign up online or in person.
cards.access_notes: Listed Tuesdays from 6–8 p.m.; participants must register and should bring their own bicycle.

cards.title: Spend the day at Music Is Art
cards.subtitle: Terminal B, Outer Harbor — September 12, 2026
cards.notes: Go for the live music, performances, dance, and visual art; plan transport home in advance and keep the day free by passing on vendor purchases.
cards.short_summary: A forthcoming public arts festival at Terminal B.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Music Is Art 2026 at Terminal B is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 12, 2026, 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; food, beverages, and shops are optional purchases.

cards.entity_name: Steel Plant Museum of Western New York
cards.title: Explore the Steel Plant Museum
cards.subtitle: Heritage DiscoveRY Center, Buffalo
cards.notes: Browse the museum’s steel-industry displays at your own pace, then use a few exhibits as prompts to trade observations about Buffalo’s industrial history.
cards.short_summary: A permanently free public museum visit in Buffalo.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steel Plant Museum of Western New York states that it is always free to the public.
cards.source_title: Steel Plant Museum of Western New York
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Heritage DiscoveRY Center; check the museum directly for current visiting arrangements.

cards.entity_name: AP Gorny: Different From the Rest
cards.title: See the AP Gorny Rare Book Room exhibition
cards.subtitle: Rare Book Room, Buffalo & Erie County Public Library
cards.notes: Visit the Rare Book Room to see the exhibition, then leave time to browse the Central Library’s public spaces and discuss the books on display.
cards.short_summary: A current free exhibition in the downtown Central Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library states that AP Gorny: Different From the Rest is free and open to the public and on view through fall 2026.
cards.source_title: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library Presents AP Gorny: Different From the Rest
cards.access_notes: At the Central Library Rare Book Room, 1 Lafayette Square; the source lists the exhibition through fall 2026.
